blocks: Your own retreat, just outside the back door.
A retreat usually means going somewhere else.
For most people, a sauna or a hot tub is somewhere you go, not something you have.
Three checked products, from about 1.2 m² to about 7.6 m² of garden.
The makers, and the products they publish.
What the rules and safety require, kept apart from practical guidance.
Two ways to take the next step.
Somewhere else A sauna or a hot tub usually means a spa, a booking and a drive.
Time An evening becomes an outing.
The garden Already there, a few steps from the back door.
The questions Space, power, water and planning are easier to answer first.
What the rules and safety require
Planning, Building Regulations, electrical work and fire. Each is sourced below.
Base, water, running costs and insurance: questions to settle with the maker, your electrician and your insurer.

Indicative footprint comparison by PlotNua. The three products checked on this page, drawn to one scale from the outside dimensions their suppliers publish. Access space, the hot tub’s stove and chimney, and any base are not drawn.
Meet the makers, browse their products, compare the three options and read the practical guide.
What you need to sort out
Start a free conversation with PlotNua. Tell us about your garden and we’ll talk it through with you, using what PlotNua has researched.
PlotNua doesn’t build or install saunas, hot tubs or cold plunges. Nothing on this page assesses your property, and nothing is booked by starting a conversation.
